finalText:
**Renamed `calcTotal` to `computeTotal` everywhere.**

I changed it in `cart.js`, `index.js`, `invoice.js`, and `report.js`, plus the comment in `cart.js`. The tests already used the new name, so I left them alone.

All 4 tests pass in 0.07s.

One heads-up: I did not keep `calcTotal` around as an old-name alias. Your test in `total.test.js` checks that it is gone, so anyone still calling the old name will break.
